title: MLK essay on mystery religions and Christianity

tellings.quote: new in fact Martin Luther King wrote a little-known essay called the influence of mystery religions on Christianity

plain: Martin Luther King wrote a little-known essay called "The Influence of the Mystery Religions on Christianity", about how the secret initiation cults of the ancient Mediterranean shaped the early church, Michels says, bringing it up beside the work of the Bible scholar Dennis MacDonald and the King James Bible of 1611. He tells it as a sign that Christianity carries older, hidden traditions inside it.
